# VRRig

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/logic/components/`](../folders/src-logic-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/components/vr.h`](../../../src/logic/components/vr.h)

## Summary

Placement of the OpenXR stage space (play area) in the world.

## Description

Host context variable emplaced by the VRRender constructor. VRControlSys moves and turns it (left stick locomotion only while stick_locomotion), RollerPlayer (VRRoller) drives it and clears stick_locomotion. transform() = translate(position) * rotateY(yaw). ChunkManagerSys uses position as a load centre while VRInput::session_running.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | `glm::vec3` | (0, 0, 0) | world position of the stage origin |
| `yaw` | `float` | 0 | radians about +Y |
| `stick_locomotion` | `bool` | true | VRControl moves the rig with the left stick; off when a system drives it |
